name: forge-pro
description: Forge Pro — an AI-native, self-QA'd marketplace for website templates and UI components.

scripts.docker:e2e: docker run --rm --init --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/workspace forge-pro-e2e pnpm --filter @forge-pro/app exec playwright test
scripts.docker:regenerate: docker run --rm --init --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/workspace forge-pro-e2e bash -lc 'node apps/app/scripts/golden-drift-check.mjs apps/app/e2e/visual.spec.ts-snapshots --check-platform && mkdir -p /tmp/goldens-before && cp -n apps/app/e2e/visual.spec.ts-snapshots/*-linux.png /tmp/goldens-before/ 2>/dev/null || true; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm turbo run build --filter=@forge-pro/app... && pnpm --filter @forge-pro/app exec playwright test e2e/visual --update-snapshots && node apps/app/scripts/golden-drift-check.mjs apps/app/e2e/visual.spec.ts-snapshots --before /tmp/goldens-before --max-ratio 0.05'
